messages:
alex_support: @maria_engineer fyi — customer (internal account 4452) just opened a high-priority ticket: after yesterday's model rollout their multi-file summarization flow started dropping earlier instructions. They say the model 'forgets the system prompt' when history > ~30k tokens. reproducible on their side. pinging runtime team. thread_ts=1797004510

maria_engineer: thanks alex. can you paste the customer's minimal repro and request-id? Any errors in the logs? :eyes: 

alex_support: they included a sanitized request. request-id: req_yx7-9932. payload: `model: "rw-long-1.3", messages: [system: very long system prompt ~12k tokens, user: uploads of four docs total ~28k tokens], max_tokens: 1024, stream: false`. They report coherent results before rollout; after rollout the model returns a response that skips the system instructions and starts summarizing only the last doc. latency normal, no 5xxs. customer tried pinning model param to previous version id but our API surfaced new variant automatically.

jin_sre: +1 on logs. I'll grep prod traces for req_yx7-9932. Can you also confirm whether they used hosted vs dedicated? That matters for routing.

alex_support: hosted. customer on standard tier.

jin_sre: found the trace. No HTTP error. Backend served tokens but I see many retry-events inside the serving runtime around KV cache miss and sequence chop. snippets from runtime logs:
```
[2026-09-14T14:12:33Z] req_yx7-9932: kv_cache_eviction: threshold=0.78, evicted_prefix=4096
[2026-09-14T14:12:33Z] req_yx7-9932: context_trimmer: truncated_history_tail=28k->20k
[2026-09-14T14:12:33Z] req_yx7-9932: selected_model_variant=rw-long-1.3-quant
```
Noting the model variant: we rolled a quantized variant during the rollout.

priya_research: interesting — our rollout notes said we enabled more aggressive prefix trimming for the quant pipeline to reduce memory. Could explain instruction loss if trimming drops system prompt. Does the customer include system prompt at the start of the messages array?

alex_support: yes, large system prompt first. customer insists it used to be honored.

maria_engineer: okay I'm replicating locally. steps I'm using:
1) create a system prompt file ~12k tokens with role=system
2) append 4 doc messages totalling ~28k tokens
3) send via curl to our hosted endpoint with model=rw-long-1.3

curl -s -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d @payload.json

payload.json sample included (sanitized).

maria_engineer: reproduction observed: when running against variant `rw-long-1.3-quant` the response ignores system role and summarizes only last documents. When forcing model=rw-long-1.2 (previous non-quant) the system instructions are respected.

priya_research: that matches theory. quant pipeline has context budget heuristics tuned for memory; looks like for extremely long histories we may be evicting earliest messages (system) preferentially. That would explain lack of 5xxs — just degraded behavior.

jin_sre: what changed in rollout? @deploy_bot can you show the canary config diff applied yesterday?

deploy_bot: Deployment diff for rollout 2026-09-14T13:00Z:
- introduced variant "rw-long-1.3-quant" with aggressive prefix trimming enabled (config: prefix_trim_strategy: balanced -> aggressive, prefix_cache: false)
- kernel tuning for lower mem on A100s
- default routing: 20% traffic to quant variant

maria_engineer: thanks. So customer hit the 20% routing. We should offer workaround: pin model to rw-long-1.2 or route them to Dedicated where they can get non-quant variant. Also need a fix to avoid trimming system prompts.

alex_support: customer asked for ETA and a temporary rollback. They are seeing regressions for live users.

priya_research: quick mitigation: we can change trimming policy to avoid evicting any message with role=system or messages with metadata tag `preserve:true`. That requires a small config change in the runtime trimming module. I can prototype but needs a safe rollout.

jin_sre: immediate ops fix: increase variant routing to 0% for rw-long-1.3-quant for standard tier until we ship fix. I can push traffic shift now if product approves.

sam_sales: flagging for account team — this customer is on an annual contract and likely to escalate to CSM if not handled quickly. Please cc me on communications.

maria_engineer: I captured reproducer and unit test. Leaving repro command here:
```
python repro_long_window.py --model rw-long-1.3 --system system_prompt.txt --docs docs.zip --max-tokens 1024 --api-key $KEY
```
Output: first line of reply should begin with "As requested, here is the summary referencing the system instruction X" but on quant variant it begins with "Summary of doc 4:"
```
# diff gist: https://internal.gists/redwood/long-window-repro/abcd1234
```

priya_research: I'll open an internal runtime patch PR that changes trimming to 'preserve-system' and adds a flag `trim_preserve_roles: ["system"]` defaulting to true. I'll run unit tests and perf bench.

jin_sre: proceeding with traffic shift now: routing change applied. rw-long-1.3-quant -> 0% for hosted-standard. Monitoring for error spike. :white_check_mark:

alex_support: told customer we've moved their traffic off the quant variant and offered pinning to rw-long-1.2. they asked for repro findings and ETA. shared that a fix is being prototyped.

priya_research: PR created: runtime#5124. Summary: avoid evicting system role during prefix trimming; small perf hit ~+1.8% mem on bench but preserves correctness. Request code review from maria and jin.

maria_engineer: reviewing now. If tests look good we should ship to canary (5% traffic) then prod. prefer to include a telemetry flag that counts how often system-preserve triggers so we can monitor impact.

jin_sre: agree. Also add alert for unexpected high truncation counts. I added a dashboard panel showing 'truncation_events.by_role' and alerted infra.

sam_sales: customer reply: "thanks — pin worked for now. please keep us posted; this feature is core to our workflow."

alex_support: next steps summarized: 1) runtime patch PR (priya) 2) maria to run perf and canary 3) jin to monitor and keep traffic off quant for standard until validated 4) sam to update customer. I'll send a postmortem after resolution.

priya_research: I'll try to fast-track review, aim for canary today if nobody objects.

maria_engineer: no objections. Please also check other variants where quant is used; add a migration note.

jin_sre: rolling back quant routing for all affected standard-tier customers now. logging shows routing change completed at 1797006580.

deploy_bot: Routing update: rw-long-1.3-quant weight -> 0% for hosted-standard (applied by jin_sre at 1797006580).

alex_support: thanks team. I'll keep thread updated with customer-facing timeline. :pray:
